title: orchiodes bifidum

This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Orchiodes bifidum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
